styles.name: drag-tree
styles.description: Drag-race Christmas tree: amber lamp pairs light top-to-bottom, then GREEN fires and the staged dragster launches down the strip

styles.name: tachometer
styles.description: Tachometer: a round ticked dial whose needle sweeps idle→redline, a thick redline arc, a flashing SHIFT lamp and an RPM digit readout

styles.name: fuel-gauge
styles.description: Fuel gauge: a round E→F dial whose needle rises with progress, beside a fuel-pump icon that blinks as the low-fuel light below 15%

styles.name: lap-circuit
styles.description: Oval track: a car dot circuits the loop; lap fraction = eased; ghost car trails behind

styles.name: pit-stop
styles.description: Race car up on jacks while the pit crew pulls and bolts on fresh tyres; the pit board ticks off four tyres as progress

styles.name: gear-shifter
styles.description: H-pattern gear shifter: stick hops 1→6 through the gate as progress grows

styles.name: odometer
styles.description: Odometer: framed number drums count 00000→99999 with progress; the last drum rolls smoothly, each digit sliding up as the next rolls in

styles.name: tunnel-headlights
styles.description: Perspective tunnel: converging road lines; headlight beams widen as the car approaches

styles.name: burnout
styles.description: Race car on the start line spinning its rear wheel; billowing tyre smoke and rubber marks reach back further as progress grows

styles.name: pistons
styles.description: Engine cutaway: pistons pump on connecting rods from a spinning crankshaft with spark flashes; more cylinders fire as progress grows

styles.name: nitro-boost
styles.description: Race car rockets along on a flickering nitro flame jet from its exhaust, speed lines streaming past; its position is the progress

styles.name: checkered-flag
styles.description: Checkered flag: a black-and-white chequered flag on a pole unfurls with progress and ripples in the wind
